about.title: About Me
about.content: I am currently a Fourth year IT student aspiring to become a SOC, with a strong passion for building dynamic, scalable, and secure applications. Beyond writing code, I continuously explore new tech stacks and emerging technologies to stay up to date with current industry trends.

projects.title: FIL-NODE
projects.description:
• Architected a secure, VPN-independent telemetry pipeline using a C#/.NET endpoint agent and Django REST
backend, continuously synchronizing remote device health and network data into a centralized PostgreSQL
database.

• Engineered a custom rule-based detection engine to analyze historical telemetry and baseline deviations, accelerating IT
incident resolution by generating automated, human-in-the-loop remediation workflows.

• Automated endpoint security baseline checks (firewall, antivirus, and storage configurations) using AES-256-GCM encryption,
transforming remote asset management into a proactive system aligned with ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST, and CIS
Benchmarks.

projects.title: FIL-TRACK (Filoil Logistics)
projects.description:
• Developed a centralized web-based multi-department digital ecosystem, eliminating isolated information silos across IT,
HR, and Finance and replacing manual, version-control-prone spreadsheet tracking.

• Engineered end-to-end asset lifecycle tracking features to trace the physical movement and operational status of
equipment across remote terminals and the central head office, providing management with real-time global oversight and
minimizing the risk of unrecorded corporate losses.

• Secured enterprise asset data by enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and client-mandated VPN network
architecture, ensuring strict data confidentiality and safe geographic tracking of equipment across all terminal locations.

projects.title: Vulnerability Assessment (ICTO, Makati City Hall)
projects.description:
• Review of a comprehensive Information Assurance and Security Plan, synthesizing multi-domain vulnerability data into a
cohesive executive risk mitigation strategy.

• Designed actionable security controls for software/hardware inventory, secure endpoint configurations, malware
defenses, and wireless access, aligning municipal IT operations with NIST and DICT Cybersecurity Frameworks.

• Authored targeted vulnerability findings addressing personnel security, backup recovery processes, and Data Privacy
Act of 2012 (RA 10173) compliance, establishing a prioritized remediation roadmap for the city government.
